t: Startup accommodation platform CuddlyNest raises $3.5M | PhocusWire
s: October 14, 2021 - CuddlyNest, an Orlando-based online travel agency, has raised $3.5 million from angel investors. Founded in 2017, this brings the company’s total funding to $14 million, all from private investors. CuddlyNest says it currently offers booking for four million listings in more than 200 countries and territories, ranging from luxury hotels to hostels and a variety of vacation rentals.
